components.name: method
values: differential gene set expression scoring | gene-set expression scores are computed at the cell level using vision and differential scores between aggregated treatment and control conditions are computed.
e-distance calculation | e-distance is calculated for all drug conditions within a cell line using scvi embeddings quantifying separability of perturbed population from controls.

mosaic platform | spheroids of 50 mixed cancer cell lines are cultured in suspension treated with individual drug perturbations including dmso controls for 24 hours then dissociated fixed and profiled using parse gigalab kit for scrna-seq with combinatorial barcoding. cells are assigned to cell lines via snp-based deconvolution.
scvi dimensionality reduction | a 10-dimensional embedding is learned for each cell using scvi.

components.name: task
values: calculate e-distances for drug conditions within each cell line.
compute 10-dimensional scvi embeddings sample 140 000 high-quality cells per cell line 6.58 million cells total and generate 2d tsne coordinates.
compute differential gene set expression scores for 7 390 gene sets using vision.
culture spheroids of mixed cell lines treat with individual drugs including dmso controls for 24 hours dissociate fix and profile using parse gigalab kit with combinatorial barcoding.
generate a giga-scale single-cell perturbation atlas of 100 million transcriptomic profiles across 50 cancer cell lines treated with 1 100 small-molecule perturbations using the mosaic platform.
perform snp-based deconvolution to assign cells to cell lines.

process sequencing data 14 96-well plates 1 786 sublibraries 1.4 trillion raw reads from 153 million cells after filtering 100.6 million cells pass minimal filters and 95.6 million cells pass full filters.
quantify lisi to assess factors driving data stratification.
